Era of AI

The Era of AI

In recent times businesses have adopted various AI concepts. One such concept is the generation of code - called "agentic programming" or "vibe coding", if you will. This is a form of software engineering - it promises to enable experts in the business to build software solutions without necessarily relying on experts in software. As a business owner, one can imagine this to be an enticing proposition, and businesses' adoption of this method of software development is working well. However, we have found that bigger businesses with more complexity seem to fall short on producing software without the need for close attention by said software experts. Such systems still seem to become unmanageable in the face of changes in business requirements and general upkeep. Thus, there remains a reliance on a software engineer, albeit of a lesser degree compared to the pre-AI era.
